column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Baal's vampire nature revealed
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Bats?! Was that bastard really a bat?!
No. More likely, it was a shadow he created!
Then $$バアル$$ is somewhere else?
Indeed. He must be hiding!
Damn it!!
Even so, what in the world happened, $$ガイ$$?!
Just as I thought... He was nothing but a hypocrite!
If what you say is true...
then there may already be a trap set somewhere in this mansion...
It seems his true identity is...
a $$血$$-drinking vampire who turns people into vampires!
Once he drinks someone dry of their $$生き血$$, they can never be human again!!
Wait!! Then the maids in this mansion, too?
Most likely, they already have...
But even if those women are pitiful people with white $$羽$$,
we must put personal feelings aside and fight, or you too will become $$血$$-drinking vampires!!
I missed that meal earlier, so I'm hungry...
You have no sense of urgency!
No, what he says is reasonable!
If we let our fury consume us, we'll be playing right into their hands.
We should leave the mansion for now and regroup.
Agreed, $$ガイ$$?!
Return to the city for now!!
Pursue $$バアル$$!
